title: Unit-compatible open localization comparison under affine ind-etale pullback
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, g:T′→T an affine morphism of Noetherian schemes whose maps on sections over affine opens are ind-etale across universes [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. Let i:Z→T, i′:Z′→T′ be closed immersions in a Cartesian square with h:Z′→Z, and j:U→T, j′:U′→T′ their complementary open immersions. For every K in D+(T_et,ModuleCat A), there exists an isomorphism E:g*R+j_*j*K ≅ R+j′_*j′*g*K such that g*(η_j,K) followed by E.hom equals η_j′,g*K, with the specified derivedPlus ordinary open units. This concerns only ordinary inverse/direct images, not closed support right adjoints.

source.place: Tag 03Q9 and sites-cohomology Tag 07A7; original ind-etale closed support proof steps 1, 6 and the open-unit part of 8.

proof.text: Complementarity and the Cartesian closed square identify U′ with U×_T T′. The open immersion j is qcqs since T is Noetherian; base-changed open immersions give the complementary open j′.

At each t∈T′ choose an affine open of T through g(t). Its preimage is affine because g is affine. The given section-ring hypothesis gives the local ind-etale chart. Apply ordinary qcqs ind-etale base change to j and j*K; transport its comparison from the chosen fibre product to U′. Compose with the inverse-image square compositor q*j*K≅j′*g*K to obtain E.

Transpose the asserted unit equation under the derived open adjunction j′*⊣R+j′_*. The exchange mate formula and the inverse-image compositor reduce the transpose of the left side to the identity by the triangle identity for j. The transpose of the right side is the identity by the triangle identity for j′. Injectivity of the adjunction bijection proves the unit equation.

theorem indEtale_openLocalization_comparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {Z Z' T T' U U' : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian T] [IsNoetherian T']
    (i : Z ⟶ T) (i' : Z' ⟶ T') [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (j : U ⟶ T) (j' : U' ⟶ T') [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsOpenImmersion j']
    (hij : Set.range i.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ)
    (hij' : Set.range i'.base = (Set.range j'.base)ᶜ)
    (h : Z' ⟶ Z) (g : T' ⟶ T) [IsAffineHom g]
    (hg : ∀ V : T.Opens, IsAffineOpen V →
      RingHom.IndEtaleAcrossUniverses (g.app V).hom)
    (sq : IsPullback h i' i g)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
    ∃ E :
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)) ≅
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j').rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j').mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)),
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).derivedPlus.unit.app K) ≫
        E.hom =
      (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j').derivedPlus.unit.app
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)
